issues.note: Left as recorded: the piece keeps its own kind and position and no wording or punctuation is invented to settle it.

layout.note: All 84 sources are placed once, in order: 43 output rows, 41 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together. Piece lengths run 42 code points at the median, so the granularity stays in the manual-v1 range. No fused section labels or crossed pairings were found. Rows were checked against the source in sampled groups by genre and against the corpus-wide statistics for every item.
